stats.notes: Baseline from IPEDS (fall 2024 entering class): counts from the ADM2024 file via the Urban Institute Education Data Portal (25,234 applied, 22,074 admitted, 4,464 enrolled), matching College Navigator's 87% admitted / 20% yield. George Mason's 2025-2026 Common Data Set exists on oiep.gmu.edu but returned HTTP 403 (bot protection) to direct and tool fetches, so CDS-only items (SAT total, GPA, residency and international splits, admission factors) are not added. SAT/ACT percentiles cover only the 19% (829) / 2% (80) of enrollees who submitted scores. Undergrad enrollment 28,334 and nonresident undergrads 1,574 are IPEDS fall 2024.

cost.notes: College Navigator estimated expenses for full-time beginning undergraduates, 2024-25: tuition and fees $14,220 in-state / $38,688 out-of-state; on-campus food and housing $15,725; books $1,288; other $3,667; total on-campus $34,900 in-state / $59,368 out-of-state. 2026-27 rates were not checked.
